title: Ember and Crown
author: Astrid Galloway
blurb: Noor Vasquez, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
